name: CryptoFormalEval
description: CryptoFormalEval is a benchmark designed to assess the ability of large language models to autonomously identify vulnerabilities in cryptographic protocols by interacting with a formal verification tool, Tamarin, using a manually validated dataset of flawed communication protocols.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark with limited but growing interest in formal-methods and security-oriented LLM evaluation.
notes: Integrates LLMs with symbolic reasoning systems; uses Tamarin theorem prover for automatic verification.
